title: Kid Friendly Mediterranean Salt Cod Tagine
description: A gentle, earthy stew of salt cod and Mediterranean vegetables that is quick to make and safe for kids.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a tagine or heavy pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion until translucent.
Add cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Pour in vegetable broth to deglaze, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Stir in diced red bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, and simmer for 5 minutes until vegetables soften.
Gently fold in the flaked salt cod and lemon juice, cooking until the fish is heated through, about 4 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and cover, letting the flavors meld for 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with a pinch of salt if needed; remember salt cod is already salty.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the tagine just before serving.
Ladle the stew into bowls and serve warm with a side of crusty bread or rice.
Let the dish cool slightly before serving to ensure the kids can eat safely.
